in_sanskrit.name: Neeraja
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lily in water
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Neeraja एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Neeraja is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Neer' meaning water and 'Aja' meaning lily. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a celestial nymph, the goddess of the lotus in the water.
